create.name: Anne Eberhardt
create.bio:
Anne Eberhardt is a yoga and meditation teacher and the founder of Bubble Yoga, a studio in St. Gallen in eastern Switzerland that also teaches online. French by background, with long ties to Australia, she has taught since 2015 and draws on Hatha yoga and the wider Vedic tradition, with more than 1,000 hours of her own training behind her. She teaches in English, French and Spanish, and runs mindfulness programmes for companies, universities and schools alongside her studio work.

Her classes range from flowing vinyasa to slow yin, restorative practice, pranayama and yoga nidra, and she brings a keen interest in anatomy to how she teaches movement. Rest, kindness and steady practice are recurring themes. Her three-morning Learn to Meditate course on Zoom introduces a simple technique she calls Being meditation, with group practice and talks on self-awareness, and she leads the studio's Path to Being 200-hour teacher training, which she frames as deepening one's own practice before teaching others. Several of her short guided meditations, including yoga nidra and practices for rest and presence, are free to hear on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Learn to Meditate Course
courses.description: Three live morning sessions of ninety minutes on Zoom, on consecutive days, with practice set in between. Anne explains how the mind works, teaches a simple Being meditation technique and helps each person set up a daily habit. Graduates may re-join later runs at no charge.

courses.title: Path to Being 200hrs Yoga Teacher Training 2027
courses.description: A 200-hour yoga teacher training led by Anne, opening with an intensive week at the Sonnennest centre in Graubünden and continuing over weekends at the St. Gallen studio until June. It covers asana, anatomy, philosophy, meditation and teaching skills, and is open to those who simply want to deepen their own practice.
courses.price: CHF 4,500 (early bird CHF 4,300 before 30 Sept 2026; accommodation for the intensive week extra)

free_resources.title: Deep Rest Meditation
free_resources.description: A fifteen-minute guided practice for letting the body and attention settle into stillness. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Yoga Nidra For Complete Relaxation
free_resources.description: A thirty-minute yoga nidra, lying down, guided by Anne through the body and breath. Free on Insight Timer.
